summary: Iteration 7 — full backend + frontend verification of (a) Studio→CRM rename, (b) cohort analytics in 4 variants (retention, tier-flow, by-channel, full triangle), (c) 10 new CRM features (LTV top, reorder candidates, look-alikes, daily brief, leaderboard, life events, wishlist CRUD, walk-ins CRUD, reply suggest). Backend pytest 24/24 PASS. Frontend smoke 100% PASS for all required testids across Manager Cohorts/Operations tabs, Customer Profile (Wishlist + Look-alikes + DOB/key_dates), Dashboard walk-ins live floor, and Inbox AI reply suggestion (real Claude reply landed in the textarea).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1502 lines; insights.py is 749 lines — both past the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting the insights router by feature (cohorts.py / leaderboard.py / wishlist.py / walkins.py / lookalikes.py) — each block is already neatly delimited by the numbered banners and would extract cleanly.

Wishlist + Walk-ins routes return resource ids under feature-specific keys (`wishlist_id`, `checkin_id`) instead of a generic `id` — this works but breaks the principle-of-least-surprise for API consumers and forced the test suite to handle 3 fallback names. Recommend adding a stable `id` alias (e.g. `id = wishlist_id` in the response model) without removing the legacy name, so future callers can rely on `id`.

Preferences endpoint is `PUT /api/preferences/{cid}` (server.py L623) but the new InsightsTabs/CustomerProfile UI for life events relies on it — there is no integration test ensuring `dob` round-trips from UI → /preferences → /insights/upcoming-events. Backend test now covers this gap (TestLifeEventsDOB::test_dob_appears_in_events).
WalkInsCard reload() swallows all errors silently (`catch { /* ignore */ }`); if /insights/walkins ever 500s in prod, the live floor will appear empty with no toast. Add a non-blocking error toast.

reply-suggest happy path verified end-to-end with Claude Sonnet (returned a 100-char tonally-correct reply). LLM failure fallback (`returns empty reply gracefully`) is asserted only in the contract — there is no negative test forcing an LLM 5xx; a monkeypatched test in insights.py would close that gap.

success_rate.backend: 100% (24/24 pytest including rename, 4 cohort variants, LTV, reorder, lookalikes, daily-brief, leaderboard week+month+invalid, life-events DOB round-trip, wishlist CRUD, walk-ins CRUD, reply-suggest)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 30+ required data-testids verified (manager-tab-cohorts/operations + 12 inner cards/tables, profile-tab-wishlist/lookalikes/preferences with pref-dob & pref-key-dates, walkins-card with live search→pick→serve, reply-suggest button populates reply-body via Claude). Studio rename confirmed: 0 occurrences of 'Vivo Studio' in shipped frontend; 'Vivo CRM' in <title>, AppShell desktop+mobile, Manager heading 'Manager CRM', and Customer DPA copy.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 acceptance criteria all met. Reusable assets: (1) /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_insights.py exercises the entire /api/insights router and the rename — 24 tests, ~10s runtime cold, including the slow triangle endpoint (cached after first call). (2) Wishlist/walkin id fields are `wishlist_id` / `checkin_id` (NOT `id`) — important when writing follow-up tests. (3) Walk-in search dropdown only appears when triggered via real keystrokes (page.type with delay) because React onChange relies on input events; `page.fill()` set the value but skipped the onChange in some render paths — use type+delay for `[data-testid="walkin-search"]`. (4) Reply-suggest dialog hits Claude Sonnet — first call ~6-8s, prefills `[data-testid="reply-body"]`. (5) Cohort triangle endpoint paginates BI /orders → cold call ~30s, warm <1s; suite waits up to 90s.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects this iteration. Initial 5 test failures were all test-script issues (wrong assumptions about response field names: id vs wishlist_id/checkin_id; wrong preferences URL: /api/customers/{id}/preferences vs the real /api/preferences/{id}). Self-corrected and re-ran green.
